attributes.action: “Introduce Vehicle-Based Motor Insurance Instead of Driver-Based Insurance”
attributes.additional_details:
Under the current UK system, a vehicle being insured does not necessarily mean another licensed driver is insured to drive it. A person can have the owner's permission and a valid driving licence, yet still commit an offence if the insurance does not cover them.

We believe insurance should primarily follow the vehicle, allowing appropriately licensed drivers to drive it with the owner's permission, subject to reasonable safeguards as  in 27 EU countries,USA, Canada,Australia,China,Japan
attributes.background: We want the Government to reform UK motor insurance law so that insurance is primarily attached to the vehicle rather than individual drivers, allowing any appropriately licensed driver to drive an insured vehicle with the owner's permission, subject to the terms of the vehicle's insurance policy.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open requesting this, which you may wish to sign:

Car Insurance Coverage to Be Vehicle-Based, Not Driver-Based
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/767219
